ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering approximately 95% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) punctate pixels accounting for approximately 5%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast punctate spots located primarily in the medial and basal regions. No large contiguous pigmentation blobs visible. High-contrast tan/white clusters located on the distal leading edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 40-45 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude, high-frequency irregular serrations and jagged excisions along the right lobe trailing edge; moderate-frequency, low-amplitude undulations along the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature transition toward distal tips; convex leading edge trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-contrast, circular, high-relief pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the outer leading edge and tip of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic irregularity and possible tissue loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe, characterized by a jagged, non-linear pixel boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy calcareous encrustation concentrated on the extreme distal periphery of the left lobe.
